quarterly_data.quarter: Wärtsilä press release: Wrtsil service agreement to support operational reliability (10-07-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Marine service order (release): Wärtsilä signed a five-year service agreement with Greece-based TMS Cardiff Gas for two newbuild 174,000 cbm LNG carriers, Al Thurayya and Al Majhoulah (each with two WinGD 5X72DF main engines, four Wärtsilä 34DF auxiliary engines and Wärtsilä gas valve units), covering Dynamic Maintenance Planning, 24/7 remote operational support and Expert Insight predictive maintenance; booked in Q3 2026. It follows the 2025 renewal of an agreement covering seven vessels in its fleet, and TMS Cardiff Gas also uses Wärtsilä Fleet Optimisation Solution across its wider fleet.
quarterly_data.figure: five-year agreement for two LNG carriers; booked Q3 2026
